note: Share of early voters through each day by the last party primary each voted in: the 2026 primaries and May runoffs (in Harris, Dallas and Tarrant counties, 2024's too, from the counties' own rosters); none = no primary in that span, including new voters. Every county's voters come from the Texas Secretary of State's daily roster files (mail ballots logged before Oct 14 aren't in them) and Harris County's own rosters, matched voter by voter to the official primary rosters. Earlier generals aren't shown: their party figures (theoelections.com) counted primaries back to 2020, so they aren't comparable. The latest day (*) can still fill in as counties add late rows.
